component.name: UnifyCloud
component.summary: Unified Multi-Cloud Manager and Automated Backup Tool

description.p: UnifyCloud is a high-performance cross-platform cloud storage manager and backup solution built with Flutter and Rclone.

ul.li: Connect and browse multiple cloud storage providers simultaneously (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, SFTP, S3, WebDAV).
Dual-pane Commander view with direct cross-cloud drag-and-drop and transfers.
Automated scheduled backups and mirror synchronization between local folders and cloud storage.
Encrypted in-memory configuration storage with zero plain-text disk footprints.
Integrated file peek, system app opener, and public shareable link generator.

description.p: Initial release featuring multi-cloud support, dual-pane explorer, and periodic folder backups.
